BBox.description: A WGS84 bounding box. Accepts ``[min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat]`` as well as an object.
BBox.title: BBox

CityFingerprint.description:
Which city files a run read: the first 12 hex of a sha256 of each, ``None`` when absent.

The run id carries engine versions and nothing about the city, so a run baked before a city
rebuild and one baked after share an id. This is how a reader tells them apart without
reading the products. Each digest is of the file's content, not its bytes on disk: the
segment ids in order; the decoded rasters with their shape and transform; the drain tables'
ids and the columns that say how a node meets the sea; and ``condition.json``'s coast-wall
fields. A rebuild that reproduces the city reproduces every digest.

coast_wall.description: condition.json: the coast wall's level, rule, ring, raise and basins.
coast_wall.title: Coast Wall

dem_conditioned.description: dem_conditioned.tif: the ground the Twin runs on, wall included.
dem_conditioned.title: Dem Conditioned

drain_edges.description: drain_edges.parquet: edge ids and the nodes each joins.
drain_edges.title: Drain Edges

drain_nodes.description: drain_nodes.parquet: node ids, cells and outfall, tidal and flap flags.
drain_nodes.title: Drain Nodes

intertidal_mask.description: intertidal_mask.tif, when the city build writes one.
intertidal_mask.title: Intertidal Mask

sea_mask.description: sea_mask.tif: open sea and tidal creek codes.
sea_mask.title: Sea Mask

bounds.description: WGS84 extent of the grid for the map BitmapLayer.

dx_m.description: Cell size in metres (30 for the city grid).
dx_m.title: Dx M

description: ``run.json``: provenance for one cycle's artifacts (SPEC.md 10.3, blueprint 9.1 ``run``).

aoi_depth_band.description: p10, p50 and p90 of mean street depth in cm at each forecast step, taken across the ensemble's members: the band the time bar draws (SPEC.md 7.2). None when the run has fewer than two members, so a deterministic run never draws a band of no width.

bundle.description: Replay bundle id, None when live.

city_fingerprint.description: Digests of the city files the run read, so a run baked on another build of the city can be told apart under the same id. None on a run baked before.

mass_balance_err.description: Relative mass-balance error of the Twin run (fraction, target < 0.001).
mass_balance_err.title: Mass Balance Err

mass_balance_ledger.description: Where the Twin's residual sits, in m3: the surface's own, the drain's own, and the two exchange gaps between them, which sum to the residual on a coupled run. A run baked before the ledger existed carries none.
mass_balance_ledger.title: Mass Balance Ledger

rain_aoi_mm_h.description: AOI-mean rain rate in mm/h at each forecast step: the storm this run was given. What-if scales it, so a run without it can only answer 'what if' about pipes.

stage_ms.description: Wall-clock per stage in ms (decode, sky, twin, ...).
stage_ms.title: Stage Ms

twin_revision.description: The Twin revision that computed the run, finer than the version in the run id - for example 1.0+coast-2026-09-28, the Twin with the city's own coastline. None on a run baked before run.json carried it.
